title: ardisia rothii

This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ardisia rothii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
